title: Verify public status endpoint returns app status
expected_result: Response status is 200 and response body includes app status information

title: Verify public demo stats endpoint returns demo statistics
expected_result: Response status is 200 and response body includes demo statistics

title: Verify student user can log in with valid credentials
steps: Send a POST request to /api/v1/auth/login with valid student email and password
expected_result: Response status is 200 and response body includes access_token and token_type

title: Verify login fails with invalid password
steps: Send a POST request to /api/v1/auth/login with valid email and invalid password
expected_result: Response status is 401 and response body includes an authentication error

title: Verify applications endpoint requires authentication
steps: Send a GET request to /api/v1/applications without an access token
expected_result: Response status is 401 and response body includes an authentication error

title: Verify authenticated student can list applications
preconditions: Student user is logged in and has an access token
steps: Log in as the student user, then send a GET request to /api/v1/applications with the bearer token
expected_result: Response status is 200 and response body is a list of applications for the authenticated user
